user.title: Nuki Web API token
user.description: Create a token at web.nuki.io → API with only **View devices** and **View and manage authorizations**. Lock and unlock stay local; this integration only manages keypad codes.

reauth_confirm.title: New Nuki Web API token
reauth_confirm.description: Nuki Web refused the saved token. Paste a new one.

error.invalid_auth: Nuki Web refused the token. Check that it has View devices and View and manage authorizations.
error.no_locks: This account has no smart locks.

abort.already_configured: This Nuki account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: The token belongs to a different Nuki account.

set_access.name: Set keypad code access
set_access.description: Changes when a keypad code works, and waits until Nuki Web shows the change.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the code and its fingerprints open the door.

valid_from.name: Valid from
valid_from.description: The code works from this moment.

valid_until.name: Valid until
valid_until.description: The code stops working at this moment.

no_date_limit.name: No date limit
no_date_limit.description: Remove both dates (applied before any date given here).

from_time.name: From time
from_time.description: Daily start time. 00:00 to 00:00 means all day.
